value.rationale: 当前批次残差来自四类已有源码解析缺口，而非来源缺失：其一，例外句“anyone outside or within its own organization, except on a need-to-know basis”实际形成受 need-to-know 与必要范围约束的披露许可；其二，“will only share ... with employees, advisors, and agents”以及“reveal ... only to agents, representatives and employees”是明示的内部/专业接收方许可；其三，“termination or expiration ... or written request”同时给出协议终止和请求触发；其四，从返还范围中排除、继续保密持有并可应请求销毁的自制分析材料构成有条件留存许可。更新在现有逐来源扫描中加入这些普通语义模式，保留原有原子、旧输出、不确定性、动作方向、材料范围与条件，不依赖来源ID、公司名或原生答案。

source_function_edits.code:
def sp_retention(spans,out):
    i=0
    while i<len(spans):
        uid=spans[i].get('id')
        raw=spans[i].get('text','')
        if not isinstance(raw,str):
            raw=str(raw)
        text=sp_low(raw)
        scope='unit:'+str(uid)
        if sp_any(text,['back-up/archival','backup/archival','back-ups or archives','backup or archive']):
            sp_add(out,['acq_retention_v3',scope,'retention_permission','backup_or_archive','backup_archival_copies','continuing_confidentiality_and_source_access_limits',raw],[uid])
        if 'single copy' in text and sp_any(text,['legal department','dispute resolution']):
            sp_add(out,['acq_retention_v3',scope,'retention_permission','dispute_resolution_record','single_copy_all_confidential_information','legal_department_only_and_continuing_confidentiality',raw],[uid])
        if sp_any(text,['required by law or regulation','required to do so by applicable law','extent required by law or regulation']) and sp_any(text,['retain','retained','copies']):
            sp_add(out,['acq_retention_v3',scope,'retention_permission','legally_required_record','source_bounded_copies','continuing_source_restrictions',raw],[uid])
        if 'internal compliance' in text and sp_any(text,['retain','retained','copies']):
            sp_add(out,['acq_retention_v3',scope,'retention_permission','internal_compliance_record','source_bounded_copies','continuing_source_restrictions',raw],[uid])
        if sp_any(text,['without retaining any copies','no copies, electronic or otherwise','no copy shall be retained','shall not retain any copy','not to make or retain copy']):
            sp_add(out,['acq_retention_v3',scope,'retention_prohibition','explicit_no_retention','source_stated_materials','source_stated_prohibition',raw],[uid])
        if 'anyone outside or within its own organization' in text and 'need-to-know' in text and 'extent necessary' in text:
            support=[uid]
            j=i+1
            stop=min(len(spans),i+5)
            while j<stop:
                support.append(spans[j].get('id'))
                j+=1
            clause=sp_context(spans,i,0,4)
            recipients=['participant_union',['internal_personnel_of',['receiving_party']],['third_parties']]
            condition=['and_condition',['need_to_know',clause],['extent_necessary',clause]]
            sp_add(out,['permission',['receiving_party'],['disclose',['confidential_information'],recipients],condition],support)
        if 'only share confidential information with its employees' in text and 'advisor' in text and 'agent' in text:
            recipients=['participant_union',['employees_of',['receiving_party']],['participant_union',['professional_advisors_of',['receiving_party']],['agents_of',['receiving_party']]]]
            sp_add(out,['permission',['receiving_party'],['disclose',['confidential_information'],recipients],['extent_necessary',raw]],[uid])
        if 'reveal the information only to our agents' in text and 'representatives and employees' in text:
            recipients=['participant_union',['employees_of',['receiving_party']],['participant_union',['agents_of',['receiving_party']],['representatives_of',['receiving_party']]]]
            condition=['and_condition',['need_to_know',raw],['and_condition',['extent_necessary',raw],['confidentiality_bound',raw]]]
            sp_add(out,['permission',['receiving_party'],['disclose',['confidential_information'],recipients],condition],[uid])
        if 'upon termination or expiration of the agreement' in text and 'upon written request by either party' in text and 'return' in text and 'destroy' in text:
            material=['information_bundle',['confidential_information'],['copies_of',['confidential_information']]]
            action=['action_alternative',['return_to',material,['disclosing_party']],['destroy',material]]
            trigger=['trigger_alternative',['agreement_termination'],['request_by',['disclosing_party']]]
            sp_add(out,['disposal_obligation',['receiving_party'],action,trigger,['no_exceptions']],[uid])
        if 'will be held by us and kept confidential' in text and 'destroyed upon your request' in text:
            material=['source_retention_material',raw]
            condition=['retention_condition',raw]
            sp_add(out,['retention_permission',['receiving_party'],material,['after_disposal'],condition],[uid])
        i+=1
